Context: 12. Assistance to Government servants in legal proceedings

3. (i) Cases filed by Government against the Government servant.No assistance is admissible in such proceedings civil or criminal. In case the proceedings conclude in the employee's favour, reimbursement of the whole or any reasonable proportion of the expenses will be considered by the Government, if it is satisfied that he was subjected to the strain of the proceedings without proper justification.
